measurement_basis: authenticated campaign activity, source inspection, and bounded verification

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment and Control campaign interfaces

outcome.observed_limitation: Before the change, normalize_scope discarded paths for kind=worktree. A checkout-scoped claim therefore became whole-worktree scope and could conflict with an unrelated repository-relative claim even when the requested files were disjoint.
outcome.other_campaign_ownership: The existing live claims remained with their recorded owner and were not displaced.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement, including capability accountability and machine-native adoption

pressure_hypothesis.title: Worktree claims cannot express a disjoint file subset
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment claim scope normalization and overlap analysis
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve repo-relative paths on checkout-bound worktree claims and compare overlap within the same checkout or shared branch while keeping unanchored repository-relative claims conservative.
